findings.claim: The unsubscribe endpoint accepts a sequential serial id with no signed token, so anyone can unsubscribe every user by enumerating ids.
findings.recommendation: Use an HMAC-signed token per saved search.

findings.claim: last_run_at and sent_at are only advanced after the whole batch, so a crash or timeout mid-loop re-sends every earlier email on the next run — duplicate alerts are guaranteed under any partial failure.
findings.evidence: Mark everything as processed once the batch is through.
findings.recommendation: Update last_run_at per search immediately after its email is sent.

findings.claim: Preferences.tsx is a client component that instantiates Resend with RESEND_API_KEY; the secret is either bundled for the browser or undefined on the client.
findings.recommendation: Send test alerts from a server action.
